body:
### Summary

Hi there, 

We'd like to get a list of package dependencies for use in our vulnerability tracker. We were using `uv export --no-dev` to omit the development deps but recently realized that this does not omit dependency groups which are also used for development.

As far as I can tell there is no easy way to only export package dependencies. Two options came to my mind:

* New flag `--only-package` or similar. Somewhat related to https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/12366
* New flag `--no-dependency-groups`. I think this can even replace `--no-dev` since uv documentation itself states that dependency-groups are intended for development packages.

What do you think?

title: Export only the package dependencies
